description: This file defines the server-side logic for the AdminLeaderboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles page load events, navigation button clicks, and session management, with some database interaction code commented out.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET page, managing page lifecycle and user interactions.

methods.description: Handles the page load event; contains commented-out code for database data binding.

methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for leaderboard button click event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: searchB_Click

methods.name: logoutB_Click
